notes.title: Operating frequency
notes.body:
Data is 5 bytes (10-byte BCD), little-endian. Digit order: byte-1 low = 10 Hz, byte-1 high = 1 Hz, byte-2 low = 1 kHz, byte-2 high = 100 Hz, byte-3 low = 100 kHz, byte-3 high = 10 kHz, byte-4 low = 10 MHz, byte-4 high = 1 MHz, byte-5 low = 1 GHz (0 fixed), byte-5 high = 100 MHz (0-3 on IC-7300 MK2).
Example: 14.257.000 MHz -> 00 00 57 42 01

Commands 00 / 03 / 05 read or set transceive frequency; command 1C 03 reads the transmit frequency in Split.

notes.title: Operating mode
notes.body:
Data is 1-2 bytes.
Byte 1 - operating mode: 00=LSB, 01=USB, 02=AM, 03=CW, 04=RTTY, 05=FM, 07=CW-R, 08=RTTY-R.
Byte 2 - filter: 01=FIL1, 02=FIL2, 03=FIL3 (optional with commands 01 and 06; FIL1/default selected when omitted).

notes.title: Turning the transceiver ON
notes.body:
To send this command through the [REMOTE] jack,
you must enter multiple “FE” characters. The required
number of “FE” entries depends on the baud rate.
• 19200 bps: 25 “FE”s
• 9600 bps: 13 “FE”s
• 4800 bps: 7 “FE”s
Example: When the baud rate is 9600 bps, enter 13 “FE”s.
13 “FE”s
F E F E F E B 6 E 0 1 8 0 1 F DF E……

notes.title: Scope waveform data
notes.body:
1  Selected or Unselected VFO
00=Selected VFO (Fixed)
2  Order of division data (Current)
3  Division number (Maximum)
01 (LAN), 11 (USB)
When data is sent to the controller (PC) through the
[LAN] port on the transceiver’s rear panel, it is sent
all at once. On the other hand, when the data is sent
through the [USB] port, it is divided into 11 segments
and sent in sequential order.
Division
number Data length
LAN 01 490
USB 11
1st data 15
later data 53
11th data 28
The 1st data sends only the wave information
(1 ~ 6) without the waveform data (7). The 2nd or
later data sends the minimum wave information (1 ~
3), and the waveform data (7).
4 Spectrum scope mode data
• 00=Center mode scope
• 01=Fixed mode scope
• 02=SCROLL-C mode scope
• 03=SCROLL-F mode scope
5  Waveform information
The waveform information differs, depending on the
Spectrum scope mode.
• In the Center mode:
Center frequency and span are sent.
See page 16 for Operating frequency data,
and page 25 for the Scope span settings
(2 ~ 6).
• In the Fixed, SCROLL-C, and SCROLL-F modes:
The lower and higher edge frequencies are sent.
